title: Drinking at the saloon with Louis and Louis' smoking
summary: Punch recalls the saloon where musicians drank, and the interviewers discuss Louis' drinking and smoking arrests, then agree to cut it.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. How long since you seen him?

Well, they had a fellow named Joe, Italian boy named Joe Cronje, or something like that. Mm-hmm. Had a saloon ready at Padilla and, Padilla and, and Sanitoba. Mm-hmm. And we, I used to meet him there. I used to meet there all the time. We could drunk together. And, uh, that's where all the boys used to meet, you know? We'd meet there. Drank all the whiskey we could and then go home and drunk. And Lewis wouldn't do that, though, would he?
Yeah, yeah, Lewis drank and he put the whiskey on and started smoking.
He put the whiskey down and he... But he doesn't drink anymore, huh? No, he don't drink anymore. But he still smoked that stuff. That stuff.
And he got busted on a couple times way back. Oh, I shouldn't have said that. No, I mean, that was in the newspapers.
I mean, that was no secret. That was no secret. That was in the newspaper. Everybody forgot. Oh, because they put it on. Okay, well, we will. Um... I don't want him to hear that. No. Whatever.

He doesn't lie. Oh, no. He doesn't want you to hear it. I wonder why Henry said that. Yeah, why don't we forget it? Yeah, get that out of here. Yeah, we'll rub it off him. Of course, of course. A lot of people don't believe he's good, no.
But when he's feeling good, I know something. Yeah.
Yeah. When he's feeling good, I know something.
